mapper.insert: WITH upsert_model AS ( INSERT INTO tc_model (model_name, comm_interface, maker, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{m.modelName}, #{m.commInterface, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{m.maker}, #{m.createdBy}, #{m.updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (model_name) DO UPDATE SET comm_interface = EXCLUDED.comm_interface, maker = EXCLUDED.maker, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING model_key ) INSERT INTO tc_model_version (model_key, model_version, status, description, created_by, updated_by) SELECT model_key, #{m.modelVersion}, #{m.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{m.description}, #{m.createdBy}, #{m.updatedBy} FROM upsert_model ON CONFLICT (model_key, model_version) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: WITH target_model AS ( SELECT model_key FROM tc_model_version WHERE model_version_key = #{m.modelVersionKey} ), update_model AS ( UPDATE tc_model SET model_name = #{m.modelName}, comm_interface = #{m.commInterface, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, maker = #{m.maker}, updated_by = #{m.updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model_key = (SELECT model_key FROM target_model) RETURNING model_key ) UPDATE tc_model_version SET model_version = #{m.modelVersion}, status = #{m.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, description = #{m.description}, updated_by = #{m.updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE model_version_key = #{m.modelVersionKey}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tc_model_version mv JOIN tc_model m ON m.model_key = mv.model_key WHERE mv.model_version_key = #{modelVersionKey}
